title.value: How to Initialize your Network? Robust Initialization for WeightNorm & ResNets
title.justification: The title is explicitly stated at the beginning of the document, indicating the focus on robust initialization strategies for WeightNorm and ResNets.
title.quote: How to Initialize your Network? Robust Initialization for WeightNorm & ResNets

analysis.description: The paper introduces a novel parameter initialization strategy for weight normalized networks with or without residual connections, addressing issues of information explosion or vanishment across layers. The strategy is based on a theoretical analysis using mean field approximation and improves the robustness, hyper-parameter choices, and learning rate of deeper networks. Extensive experiments on image datasets demonstrate its superiority over existing methods.

type.justification: The paper's main contribution is the theoretical derivation of a novel initialization strategy, supported by mean field approximation and theoretical analysis, as opposed to being purely experimental.
type.quote: The main contribution of this work is the theoretical derivation of a novel initialization strategy for weight normalized ReLU networks, with and without residual connections, that prevents information flow from exploding/vanishing in forward and backward pass.
